definitions: The act or an instance of becoming less bright, intense, or distinct.
A hairstyle in which the hair is cut progressively shorter from the top of the head down to the neck, often to the skin.
A shot in golf or other sports that curves gently to the right (for a right-handed player).
examples: The fades in the old photographs were quite noticeable.
He got a fresh fade at the barbershop.
Her golf shot had a slight fade.
